title: Warm Earthy Ukrainian Khus Khus Pilaf
description: This earthy and indulgent Ukrainian dish features khus khus and is perfect for a cold winter night, it is also brine-wet and FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Rinse the brown rice in a fine mesh strainer until the water runs clear.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the khus khus and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, salt, black pepper, and dried thyme, and bring to a boil.
Add the brown rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
